title: CD7 CAR-T cells eliminate chronic myeloid leukemia stem cells specifically and effectively.
snippet: Leukemia stem cells (LSCs) in chronic myeloid leukemia (CML) are associated with disease recurrence and progression, cannot be eliminated by tyrosine kinase inhibitors (TKIs), and affect TKI discontinuation in CML patients.
